basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student from Las Vegas, currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science. I have a keen interest in mobile gaming, particularly Fate/Grand Order. I often spend my evenings playing games or watching anime, with Kimetsu no Yaiba being a recent favorite. I'm single and enjoy exploring local events and the vibrant nightlife here in Vegas. My online activity spikes during late nights and weekends when I'm not swamped with assignments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science from my ongoing studies, which complements my interest in gaming and technology. Most of my knowledge about games like Fate/Grand Order comes from extensive gameplay and community discussions. I also keep up with updates and patches through online forums and Reddit threads.
